description: Load this skill whenever the project uses Mermaid diagrams — flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, Gantt charts, or any Mermaid-rendered visualization. Under no circumstances render a Mermaid diagram without an accessible title, description, and text-based alternative. Absolutely always add accTitle: and accDescr: (no %% prefix — that is the comment syntax and will be silently ignored) to every diagram.
